tools.name: get_condition_details
tools.description: Fetch in-depth treatment details and clinical focus for a specific condition (params: url) -> {title, url, summary, key_points}

url.description: URL of the condition treatment page (defaults to depression treatment)

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.description: Get facility contact information, phone numbers, email, and admissions intake links -> {facility_name, phone, alt_phone, email, state, services, hours, insurance_verification_url, contact_url}

tools.name: list_conditions
tools.description: List mental health disorders and conditions treated (params: target_audience, query) -> {count, conditions: [{title, url, target_audience}]}

tools.name: list_programs
tools.description: Browse available treatment programs offered by Elevate Recovery (params: filter) -> {count, programs: [{title, url}]}
